pairs: In the same time, Joshua called the Reubenites,
and the one half tribe of Manasseh.
Fecistis omnia quæ præcepit vobis Moyses famulus Domini:
“You have done all that Moses, the servant of the Lord, instructed you.
You have also obeyed me in all things.
nec reliquistis fratres vestros longo tempore,
Neither have you forsaken your brothers during this long time,
keeping the orders of the Lord your God.
Quia igitur dedit Dominus Deus vester fratribus vestris quietem et pacem,
Therefore, since the Lord your God has given your brothers peace and quiet,
et ite in tabernacula vestra, et in terram possessionis,
and go into your tents and into the land of your possession, which Moses,
quam tradidit vobis Moyses famulus Domini trans Jordanem:
the servant of the Lord, delivered to you beyond the Jordan.
And may you continue to observe attentively,
et opere compleatis mandatum et legem quam præcepit vobis Moyses famulus Domini,
and to work to fulfill, the commandment and the law that Moses,
the servant of the Lord, instructed to you,
et ambuletis in omnibus viis ejus,
so that you may love the Lord your God,
and walk in all his ways, and keep all his commandments,
ac serviatis in omni corde, et in omni anima vestra.
and serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”
Qui reversi sunt in tabernacula sua.
And they returned to their tents.
Dimidiæ autem tribui Manasse possessionem Moyses dederat in Basan:
Now to the one half tribe of Manasseh, Moses had given a possession in Bashan. And therefore,
to the one half that was left over,
dedit Josue sortem inter ceteros fratres suos trans Jordanem ad occidentalem plagam.
Joshua gave a lot among the remainder of their brothers across the Jordan, in the western region.
Cumque dimitteret eos in tabernacula sua, et benedixisset eis,
And when he had blessed them and dismissed them to their tents,
In multa substantia atque divitiis revertimini ad sedes vestras,
“Return to your settlements with much substance and wealth,
dividite prædam hostium cum fratribus vestris.
Divide the spoils of your enemies with your brothers.”
et abierunt filii Ruben, et filii Gad,
and the sons of Gad, and the one half tribe of Manasseh returned,
et dimidia tribus Manasse, a filiis Israël de Silo,
and they went away from the sons of Israel at Shiloh,
ut intrarent Galaad terram possessionis suæ,
so that they might enter into Gilead, the land of their possession,
quam obtinuerant juxta imperium Domini in manu Moysi.
which they had obtained according to the order of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.
Cumque venissent ad tumulos Jordanis in terram Chanaan,
And when they had arrived at the hills of the Jordan in the land of Canaan,
ædificaverunt juxta Jordanem altare infinitæ magnitudinis.
they built an altar of immense magnitude beside the Jordan.
And when the sons of Israel had heard of it,
et ad eos certi nuntii detulissent, ædificasse filios Ruben,
and certain messengers had reported to them that the sons of Reuben, and of Gad,
et Gad, et dimidiæ tribus Manasse, altare in terra Chanaan,
and of the one half tribe of Manasseh had built an altar in the land of Canaan,
upon the hills of the Jordan,
so that they might go up
Et interim miserunt ad illos in terram Galaad Phinees filium Eleazari sacerdotis,
And in the interim, they sent to them, in the land of Gilead, Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the priest,
And they went to the sons of Reuben,
et dimidiæ tribus Manasse in terram Galaad,
and of the one half tribe of Manasseh, in the land of Gilead,
“All the people of the Lord declare this:
Why have you forsaken the Lord, the God of Israel,
and by withdrawing from the worship of him?
an parum vobis est quod peccastis in Beelphegor,
Is it a small thing to you that you have sinned with Baal of Peor,
et usque in præsentem diem macula hujus sceleris in nobis permanet,
and that the stain of that crime continues among us, even to the present day?
And many of the people have fallen.
And yet you have forsaken the Lord today,
et cras in universum Israël ira ejus desæviet.
and tomorrow his wrath will rage against all of Israel.
Quod si putatis immundam esse terram possessionis vestræ,
But if you consider the land of your possession to be unclean,
cross over to the land in which is the tabernacle of the Lord,
But do not withdraw from the Lord,
tantum ut a Domino et a nostro consortio non recedatis,
ædificato altari præter altare Domini Dei nostri.
by building an altar contrary to the altar of the Lord our God.
Nonne Achan filius Zare præteriit mandatum Domini,
Did not Achan, the son of Zerah, go against the commandment of the Lord,
et super omnem populum Israël ira ejus incubuit?
and so his wrath was laid over all the people of Israel?
And he was only one man.
atque utinam solum periisset in scelere suo.
If only he had perished in his wickedness alone!”
and of the one half tribe of Manasseh responded to the leaders of the delegation from Israel:
si prævaricationis animo hoc altare construximus,
If we have constructed this altar with intent of transgression,
et si ea mente fecimus ut holocausta,
And if we have acted with a mind so that we might present upon it holocausts,
et pacificas victimas super eo imponeremus,
we have acted with this greater thought and design,
Cras dicent filii vestri filiis nostris:
Tomorrow your sons will say to our sons:
‘What is there between you and the Lord,
The Lord has stationed the river Jordan as the border between us and you,
you have no part in the Lord.’
et idcirco partem non habetis in Domino:
et per hanc occasionem avertent filii vestri filios nostros a timore Domini.
your sons would turn away our sons from the fear of the Lord.
And so we sought something better,
Let us build us an altar,
sed in testimonium inter nos et vos,
but as a testimony between us and you,
and between our descendants and your progeny,
so that we may serve the Lord,
et juris nostri sit offerre et holocausta,
and so that it may be our right to offer holocausts,
et nequaquam dicant cras filii vestri filiis nostris:
and so that tomorrow your sons may not say to our sons:
Non est vobis pars in Domino.
‘You have no part in the Lord.’
And if they decide to say this,
but instead as a testimony between us and you.’
May this wickedness be far from us,
such that we would withdraw from the Lord,
by constructing an altar to offer holocausts,
contrary to the altar of the Lord our God,
quod exstructum est ante tabernaculum ejus.
which was built before his tabernacle.”
Phinees sacerdos, et principes legationis Israël,
the priest, and the leaders of the delegation who were with him,
et verba filiorum Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiæ tribus Manasse,
And they accepted very willingly the words of the sons of Reuben,
and of Gad, and of the one half tribe of Manasseh.
Dixitque Phinees filius Eleazari sacerdos ad eos:
And Phinehas, the priest, the son of Eleazar,
Nunc scimus quod nobiscum sit Dominus,
said to them: “Now we know that the Lord is with us.
quoniam alieni estis a prævaricatione hac,
For you are a stranger to this transgression.
et liberastis filios Israël de manu Domini.
And so you have freed the sons of Israel from the hand of the Lord.”
Reversusque est cum principibus a filiis Ruben et Gad de terra Galaad,
And he returned with the leaders, from the sons of Reuben and of Gad, out of the land of Gilead,
And the word pleased all who heard it.
And the sons of Israel praised God,
et nequaquam ultra dixerunt, ut ascenderent contra eos,
and they no longer said that they would go up against them,
atque pugnarent, et delerent terram possessionis eorum.
and fight, and destroy the land of their possession.
Vocaveruntque filii Ruben, et filii Gad, altare quod exstruxerant,
And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad called the altar that they had built:
Testimonium nostrum, quod Dominus ipse sit Deus.
Our testimony that the Lord himself is God.
